verdicts.reason: A is not a real resize. It pastes the original portrait layout onto the square canvas without rearranging anything. The red stripe stops short and leaves an odd white strip on the right, there is a large empty white area on the left, and the stripes and card are pushed off-centre, though the card, text and stripe colours survive intact. B breaks the structure: the stripes stop at about 88% of the height and leave a dead white band at the bottom, uneven white gaps split the stripes apart, the card has lost its bottom edge and merges into the band, and 'TRAVEL MUGS' sits jammed against where the stripes end.
